## Where
Repo or snippet, file, function names. Paste the smallest code that reproduces it.

## Expected
Which arrow/block/flag should (or shouldn't) be there.

## Actual
What Unfold shows instead.

## Language / framework
e.g. PHP 8.3, Laravel 11

The fix ships with a fixture in `test/fixtures/` that reproduces this.
